 2026 Holiday Shopping at Target: Answers to Guests’ Most Frequently Asked Questions
 Updated 6:00am CT | Nov 5, 2026 
 Copy link to share 
 Link copied 
 Target is making it easier for guests to shop for gifts they can’t wait to give with thousands of new items, major deals throughout the holiday season and flexible shopping options. Here are the most frequently asked questions to help guests make the most of holiday shopping at Target.
 Deals and promotions
 Q: 
 When are Target's Early Black Friday deals?
 A: 
 You can take advantage of Early Black Friday deals from Nov. 5-7.
 Q: 
 What are Target's top Early Black Friday deals?
 A: 
 Target’s top Early Black Friday deals include:
 40% off sweatshirts & sweatpants
 40% off select toys
 40% off lights, wreaths, garlands & porch pots
 Up to 50% off kitchen appliances
 30% off Levi’s apparel
 Q: 
 Where can I find Target's latest holiday deals?
 A: 
 You can discover the latest holiday deals on Target.com, the Target app and through the Target Weekly Ad .
 Q: 
 What is Target's Deal of the Day, and how can I take advantage of these limited-time offers?
 A: 
 Deal of the Day offers a limited-time, one-day-only deal on popular products and must-have gifts. A new daily deal will be available every day from Nov. 1 through Dec. 24. New this year, you can preview the next day's featured Deal of the Day one day in advance, making it easier to plan ahead and score the deals you want.
 Q: 
 Will Target offer additional deals throughout the holiday season?
 A: 
 Yes. Guests can look forward to limited-time offers most Thursdays through Saturdays throughout the holiday season, as well as sales for key moments like Black Friday and Cyber Monday.
 Q: 
 Can I combine holiday deals, coupons, Target Circle offers and gift card promotions?
 A: 
 Some offers can be combined, depending on the promotion. You should review each offer's terms and conditions for eligible items, purchase requirements and exclusions. Here is additional information about coupons and deals and current promotions .
 Q: 
 Does Target price match holiday deals?
 A: 
 Beginning Nov. 1 through Dec. 24, Target's Holiday Price Match Guarantee helps you shop with confidence by matching Target's own prices if they go lower later in the season.
 Store hours and ways to shop
 Q: 
 What are Target's holiday store hours, and how can I check my local store hours?
 A: 
 From Nov. 29 through Dec. 23, store hours will be temporarily extended for the holiday season. Extended hours vary by location. You can find hours for your local store using Target's Store Locator .
 Q: 
 Is Target open on Thanksgiving, Black Friday, Christmas Eve, Christmas Day, New Year's Eve and New Year's Day?
 A: 
 Here are the specific details:
 Thanksgiving (Nov. 26): All stores closed
 Black Friday (Nov. 27): Stores open at 6 a.m. local time and close at current closing time Starbucks will open when your store opens and will close at normal closing time
 Christmas Eve (Dec. 24): All stores close by 8 p.m. local time
 Christmas Day (Dec. 25): All stores closed
 New Year’s Eve (Dec. 31): All stores open
 New Year’s Day (Jan. 1): Store hours vary by location. Guests can find the hours for any store using Target's Store Locator 
 Q: 
 What pickup and delivery options does Target offer during the holidays?
 A: 
 Guests can shop when and how they choose with Order Pickup, Drive Up, Same-Day Delivery and next-day delivery on eligible items. Options, pricing and timing vary by item and location, so guests should check Target.com or the Target app for availability and estimated pickup or delivery times.
 Holiday offerings
 Q: 
 What are Target's plans for the holiday season?
 A: 
 Target is putting gifting at the heart of the holidays , making it easier and more affordable for families to find perfect gifts and celebrate in style. This season, guests can discover more than 8,000 new stylish gifts they can't wait to give, with more than half available only at Target and thousands priced at $5 and under. From must-have toys and exclusive brands to festive decor and everything needed to host and entertain, Target is bringing together inspiring finds, incredible value and convenient ways to shop — plus exciting new arrivals and deals throughout the season.
 Q: 
 What's new at Target for the holidays?
 A: 
 You can discover more than 8,000 new holiday gifts, with more than half exclusive to Target and thousands priced at $5 and under. Our holiday assortment features a mix of owned and national brands, as well as buzzy emerging brands and exclusive collaborations, with style, design and value at the center. It’s a combination that brings Target’s merchandising authority to life, pairing what’s new and on-trend with the accessible prices guests are looking for.
 This season, Target is leaning into one of the season's biggest trends: luxe-for-less gifting. This year's assortment includes 100% cashmere (excluding functional trim) starting at $25, pajamas for all from $10, festive decor from $5, faux fur throws at $30, top toys from LEGO , Barbie and Nintendo , new and exclusive gifts from prestige, emerging and global beauty brands at Target Beauty Studio , nostalgic sweet treats and host gifts from Favorite Day and exclusive finds for sports and wellness fans, making it easy for guests to find gifts that feel elevated at every price point.
 For more details, explore our guide of new holiday gifts .
 Q: 
 What are Target's top toys this holiday season?
 A: 
 Target is helping you find exciting toys for every interest and budget, with sought-after brands like LEGO, Barbie, Disney and Nintendo; more than 1,000 toys under $10; and more than 500 only-at-Target finds.
 Target’s Bullseye’s Top Toys List spotlights 50 must-have gifts spanning the year’s biggest trends, with prices starting at just $4.99. More than half of the list are exclusive to Target. Expanded LEGO, plush and kids’ collectibles sections make it easier to discover the fun.
 Target is making discovery easy for you with our most expansive digital Holiday Kids’ Catalog . Available on Target.com and the Target app, the immersive experience features nearly 500 items, including Target’s Bullseye's Top Toys List, plus interactive content, video reviews and toy demonstrations.
 Q: 
 Does Target have a holiday Thanksgiving meal deal this year?
 A: 
 Yes. Good & Gather frozen turkey returns at just 79 cents per pound for the third consecutive year, wherever it's sold. Families can also serve a complete Thanksgiving meal for six for $30, maintaining last year's $5-per-person value.
 Target's Thanksgiving meal includes: Butterball Premium Whole Young Turkey, up to 10 lb.
 Good & Gather Russet Potatoes , 3 lb. bag
 Ocean Spray Jellied Cranberry Sauce , 14 oz.
 Del Monte French Style Green Beans , two 14.5 oz cans
 Campbell's Condensed Cream of Mushroom Soup , 10.5 oz
 Good & Gather French Fried Onions , 6 oz
 Stove Top Stuffing Mix for Turkey , 6 oz.
 Heinz Homestyle Turkey Gravy , 12 oz.
 Favorite Day Take & Bake Baguette , two count
 With an expanded assortment of $5 sides, pies, appetizers and wine and limited-time offers throughout Nov. 3, Target is making it easy and affordable for guests to bring their own twist to Thanksgiving and Friendsgiving traditions.
 Nearly 60 new food and beverage items at Target make it easy to discover new favorites alongside Thanksgiving staples.
 Returns
 Q: 
 What is Target's holiday return policy, and when is the last day to return a holiday purchase?
 A: 
 For qualifying purchases, we’re giving you extra time to return purchases made between Nov. 1 and Dec. 24, 2026. The return window begins Dec. 26, 2026. Here's how it works:
 Electronics & Entertainment items (excluding Apple and Beats ): You’ll have 30 days from Dec. 26 to make a return. Items must be returned by Jan. 24, 2027.
 Apple & Beats products and mobile phones (unlocked or pre-paid): You'll have 14 days from Dec. 26 to make a return. Items must be returned by Jan. 8, 2027.
 Target Plus items: Most Target Plus items (excluding seasonal holiday décor) will have 30 days from Dec. 26 to make a return. Items must be returned by Jan. 24, 2027. For more information, including details on extended return windows for Target Circle Cardholders and Target Circle 360 members, refer to Target’s return policy .
